# PastForward

> Real 12-inch upcycled records with the album printed on the centre label, made to hang. Posters, prints and polaroids too. Delivered across India.

PastForward makes wall decor from music. The main product is an upcycled record: a real 12-inch vinyl record that already had a life, cleaned up, with album artwork printed on the centre label. It is sold to hang on a wall, not to play, and comes with a wall hook. The same designs are also sold as posters, square prints and polaroid-style cards. Anything not in the catalogue can be requested as a custom order.

- **Website**: https://pastforward.shop
- **Delivers to**: India only
- **Delivery time**: 7–10 days from order
- **Delivery cost**: Delivery is free, anywhere in India.
- **Payment**: UPI, cards and net banking. Cash on delivery isn't available yet.
- **Returns**: made to order, so no change-of-mind returns. If an order arrives damaged or wrong, email within 7 days of delivery for a replacement or refund.
- **Contact**: contact@pastforward.shop · Instagram @pastforward.shop

## Formats and prices
- **Vinyl** (12-inch record, ⌀305mm): ₹999
- **A3 poster** (297 × 420mm): ₹299
- **A5 poster** (148 × 210mm): ₹199
- **10×10 print** (254 × 254mm): ₹249
- **Polaroid card**: ₹99

## Bundles
- **Any 3 records**: ₹2,499 (save ₹498) — Three 12-inch records, any albums. The classic trio for one wall.
- **A record + its A3 poster**: ₹1,149 (save ₹149) — The album on vinyl and the same album as an A3 poster, hung side by side.
- **Any 3 A3 posters**: ₹749 (save ₹148) — Three A3 posters, 297 × 420mm. A full row for less than the price of a record.
- **Any 5 A5 posters**: ₹799 (save ₹196) — Five A5 posters for a desk, a shelf or a small gallery wall.
- **10 polaroids**: ₹699 (save ₹291) — Ten polaroid-style cards for a string of lights, a mirror or a corkboard.
One bundle applies automatically per order at checkout (whichever saves the most).
